name: designsetgo/section
title: Section
description: Vertical stacking container for sections and content areas. Perfect for building layouts with consistent spacing. Can be nested within other sections for complex page structures.

attributeDescriptions.tagName: HTML tag to use for the section container (div, section, article, header, footer, main, aside)
attributeDescriptions.constrainWidth: Whether to constrain the content to a maximum width
attributeDescriptions.contentWidth: Maximum width for the content area (CSS value like 1200px or 80%)
attributeDescriptions.style: WordPress block style object containing spacing, colors, and typography settings
attributeDescriptions.hoverBackgroundColor: Background color when hovering over the section
attributeDescriptions.hoverTextColor: Text color when hovering over the section
attributeDescriptions.hoverIconBackgroundColor: Icon background color on hover (passed to child blocks via context)
attributeDescriptions.hoverButtonBackgroundColor: Button background color on hover (passed to child blocks via context)
attributeDescriptions.overlayColor: Semi-transparent overlay color for background images
attributeDescriptions.overlayGradient: Semi-transparent overlay gradient for background images (takes precedence over overlayColor when set)
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTop: Shape divider style for the top edge (wave, tilt, curve, etc.)
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopColor: Color of the top shape divider
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopHeight: Height of the top shape divider in pixels
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopWidth: Width stretch percentage of the top shape divider
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopFlipX: Flip the top shape divider horizontally
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopFlipY: Flip the top shape divider vertically
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopFront: Render the top shape divider in front of content
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerTopBackgroundColor: Background color behind the top shape divider
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottom: Shape divider style for the bottom edge
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomColor: Color of the bottom shape divider
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomHeight: Height of the bottom shape divider in pixels
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomWidth: Width stretch percentage of the bottom shape divider
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomFlipX: Flip the bottom shape divider horizontally
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomFlipY: Flip the bottom shape divider vertically
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomFront: Render the bottom shape divider in front of content
attributeDescriptions.shapeDividerBottomBackgroundColor: Background color behind the bottom shape divider

attributes.content: Vertical stacking container for sections and content areas with consistent spacing. Can be nested for complex layouts.
